checks.query:
SELECT count(*) AS rows,
    min(tpep_pickup_datetime)::VARCHAR AS min_pickup, max(tpep_pickup_datetime)::VARCHAR AS max_pickup,
    count(*) FILTER(WHERE tpep_pickup_datetime IS NULL) AS null_pickup,
    count(*) FILTER(WHERE strftime(tpep_pickup_datetime,'%Y-%m') <> '2025-01') AS out_of_file_month,
    count(*) FILTER(WHERE tpep_dropoff_datetime <= tpep_pickup_datetime) AS nonpositive_duration,
    count(*) FILTER(WHERE fare_amount < 0) AS negative_fare,
    count(*) FILTER(WHERE trip_distance <= 0) AS nonpositive_distance,
    count(*) FILTER(WHERE passenger_count IS NULL) AS missing_passenger_count,
    count(*) FILTER(WHERE PULocationID IS NULL OR PULocationID NOT IN (SELECT LocationID FROM zones)) AS unmatched_pickup_zone,
    count(*) FILTER(WHERE DOLocationID IS NULL OR DOLocationID NOT IN (SELECT LocationID FROM zones)) AS unmatched_dropoff_zone
    FROM read_parquet('/Users/hudson/Documents/GitHub/Products/BackIntel/BackIntel/data/output/dataset-discovery-20261114/nyc-yellow-q1-2025/yellow_tripdata_2025-01.parquet')
